paite: Jesu'n amaute houpih in akiang uah gentehna thu agen nawn hi,
heading: Kitenna Ankuang Gentehna / (Luk 14.15-24)
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

paite: "Van lalgam tuh kumpipa kuahiam atapa a dia kitenna ankuanglui toh teh ahi.
english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

paite: Huan kitenna ankuang um dia achialte sam ding in asikhate asawl a, himahleh ahong nuam kei uh.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

paite: Ama'n, ka chialte kiang ah, 'ngai dih ua, ka ankuang amanta; ka bawngtalte leh ka gan vak thaute ka gouta a, bang teng amanta hi; kitenna ankuang um ding in hong paita un,' chi un, chi in sikha dang asawl nawn hi.
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

paite: Himahleh ana limsak kei ua, khat a lou ah akuan a, khat asumsinna ah apaimang hi.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

paite: Midangte'n asikhate aman ua, zumhuaitak in abawl ua, ahihlumta uhi.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa athangpaita a; asepaihhon asawl a, tualthatte ahihmang a, akhua uh leng ahalsakta hi.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

paite: Asikhate kiang ah, 'kitenna ankuang man ahita, ka chialte ne tak ahi kei uh.
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

paite: Huaiziak in lamlian ah pai unla, mi na muh peuhpeuh uh kitenna ankuang um ding in chial un,' achi hi.
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

paite: Huchi in huai sikhate apawt ua, lamlian a va pai in, amuh peuhmah uh migilou leh mihoihte leng apikhawm vek uhi. Huchi in michialte in kitenna dantan ahong dimta hi.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

paite: "Himahleh kumpipa michialte enkhe ding a ahong lutleh kitenna puan silhloumi khat huai ah amu hi.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, 'Lawm, bangchidan a kitenna puan silh lou a hiai a hong lut na hia?' achi hi. Amah adai dide hi.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

paite: Kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, 'Akhut leh akhe gak unla, polam mial ah paikhia un; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding,' achi hi.
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

paite: Chialte tampi ahi ua, telte zaw tawmchik ahi uh," achi hi.
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

paite: Huai lai in Pharisaite athugen a amattheihna ding dan akikum uhi.
heading: Siah Thu A Dotna / (Mar 12.13-17; Luk 20.20-26)
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

paite: Huan amau anungzuite uleh Herod pawlte akiang ah asawl ua, huai mite'n, "Sinsakpa, midiktak na hi a, diktak in Pathian thu na hilh a, kuamah deihsak tuam leh maivil tuam na nei kei chih ka thei uh.
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

paite: Huaiziak in bangchi na sa a, hon hilh in, Kaisar kiang a siah piak asiang hia siang lou?" achi uhi.
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

paite: Jesu'n agitlouhdan uh ana thei a, "Lepchiahte aw, bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

paite: Na siahsum uh hon ensak un," achi hi. Huan akiang ah makhai ahon la uhi.
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Kaisar a," achi uh. Ama'n akiang uah, "Huchi ahih nung Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah pia un," achi hi.
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

paite: Hiai thute azaktak un lamdang asa mahmah ua, amah nusia in, apaimangta uhi.
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

paite: Huai ni mah in, akiang ah Saddukaite, thohnawnna a-om kei chite ahong pai ua;
heading: Thohnawnna Thu A Dotna / (Mar 12.18-27; Luk 20.27-40)
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

paite: akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, mi ta nei lou in sileh, a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi akhahsak ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

paite: "Ahi a, koute lak ah sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, asi a, chi akhah louh ziak in a-unaupa luah ding in azi anutsiat hi.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

paite: Huchi mah bang in anihna in aluah a, athumna in aluah lai a, asagihna tan in aluah chiat uhi.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

paite: Atawp in avek ua asih nung un numei mah leng hong sita hi.
english: After them all, the woman died.

paite: Huchi in thohnawnna ah amau sagihte lak ah akua pen zi ahi dia? Avek un lah anei kha chiat ngal ua? chi in," adong uhi.
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un na ngaikhial nak uhi.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

paite: Thohnawn hun ah zi leh pasal a kitenna a-om nawn kei a, van a angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh," achi hi.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

paite: Himahleh, misi thohnawnna thu Pathian in na kiang ua agen na sim kei ua hia?
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

paite: "Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak Pathian, Jakob' Pathian ka hi, Pathian zaw misite Pathian ahi kei a, ahingte Pathian ahi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

paite: Mipite'n huai azak un athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

paite: Jesu'n Saddukaite selkhia ahi chih Pharisaite'n azak un akikhawm uhi.
heading: Thupiak Thupipen Thu A Dotna / (Mar 12.28-34; Luk 10.25-28)
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

paite: Huchi in alak ua dansiammi khat in, amah ze-et in thu adong hi.
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

paite: "Sinsakpa, dan ah bang thupiak pen ahia thupipen?" achi hi.
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian tuh na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi, chih.
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

paite: Huai thupiak thupipen leh poimohpen ahi.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

paite: Huan a zom in, akibatpih hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na inveng leng na it ding ahi, chih.'
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

paite: Huai thupiak nihte ah dan leh zawlneite thu tengteng akikhaikhawm vek," achi hi.
english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

paite: Huan Pharisaite akikhop lai un Jesu'n amaute thu adong hi.
heading: Messia Tungtang A Dotna / (Mar 12.35-37; Luk 20.41-44)
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

paite: "Khrist bangchi na sa ua? Kua tapa ahia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "David tapa," achi uh.
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchidan in ahia David in Kha a amah Toupa, achih?
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

paite: "Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek nuai a ka koih masiah ka taklam ah tu in,' achih?
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

paite: David in amah Toupa, achih ngalleh, bangchi in atapa ahi dia?" achi hi.
english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

paite: Kuamah in kam khat in leng adawng thei kei ua, huai ni a kipan kuamah in thudang adong ngam nawnta kei uhi.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
